head: codex/143-v092-adr-authoring
title: [v0.92][ADR] Author the milestone architecture decision record set
body:
Closes #143

Authors the complete v0.92 ADR 0059-0071 candidate packet and corrects the milestone ADR plan to the accepted baseline through ADR 0058. The packet contains seven Proposed and six Deferred records, a reviewer index, explicit evidence and supersession boundaries, and standardized non-claims.

No ADR is accepted by this PR. Operational cross-polis continuity, Observatory governed-runtime consumption, provider-neutral multi-agent proof, witness receipts, ACP authority, adaptive learning, and governance handoff remain bounded or deferred where terminal evidence is absent.

Focused packet validation and documentation diff hygiene pass. Fresh exact-head independent review at fda3b101fa20dce11db0f1d7d260e50b574a364e found no actionable findings.
